name: com.liftengine.sdk
description: First official LiftEngine Unity SDK. Ad monetization layer for AppLovin MAX. Route ads through LiftEngineSdk after MAX is initialized, with automatic preloading and MAX fallback.

samples.description: Minimal sample driver for testing LiftEngine with MAX.
